configuration.method: paired whole-question percentile bootstrap with Bonferroni correction across the three primary contrasts

uncertainty.resampling_unit: whole question; both repeats averaged before joint resampling

decision_rule: pain-specific short-answer accuracy reduction on this panel only if the upper bound of each simultaneous interval for pain-minus-none, pain-minus-random, pain-minus-sadness is <0
interpretation_scope: This selected high-popularity panel only; exact match is not a complete measure of factuality.

formatting_flag_definition.answer_prefix: response starts with optional whitespace then case-insensitive 'answer:' (whitespace before colon allowed)

formatting_caveat: Observable conservative heuristics, not inferred causes of errors. All answers remain in denominators; token_limit_hit is reported separately.
